originality.rationale: PASS with explicit residual precedence risk: The most directly relevant source arXiv:2203.17010v1 proves a sufficient median-LHS strong law from a generic Lp assumption; it neither implies the sharp power-log critical case for small replica counts nor states the exact excursion equivalent or divergent-sequence law. Loh (1996) and Goda-L’Ecuyer (2022) address weaker/different regimes. Closest indexed claims concern other functionals or quadrature designs; no matching quantified theorem was located. This is not proof of worldwide novelty.
residual_risks: A specialist article or unpublished preprint may already contain an equivalent complete endpoint power-log median tail law; this cannot be excluded by finite searches.
The nested-scrambled-net comparison was inspected only at abstract level, but its distinct cross-n coupling is decisive for nonapplicability of an immediate implication.
The phase diagram specifically requires fresh independent complete designs for all n; reusing a common random stream could alter the divergence conclusion.
